The '''Dractuvian grazing creature''' was a large, four-legged animal that grazed on the fields of the planet [[Dractu]]. These creatures roamed alone across the expansive fields of low, tufted, plant-like vegetation, where they fed. The animals were quite strong and ran quickly.

==History==
[[File:DractuDonkeyRun.jpg|left|thumb|200px|The grazing beast ran away]]
One day, the [[Chef/Legends|chef]]-[[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] visited [[Dractu]],<ref name="CWA" /> a planet in the [[Mid Rim]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> in search of a [[Dractuvian cave slug|local cave slugs]], which he believed to be a delicacy. Along the way, Dexter accidentally stepped into a pit of viscous liquid, and by the time he realized it, he could not get out on his own. His [[Unidentified Dractuvian warrior|unfazed guide]] then tore a long [[Vine/Legends|vine]] from a [[Tree/Legends|tree]], handed one end to the Besalisk, tied the other end to the leg of a grazing creature nearby, and struck the animal on the thigh, after which the creature pulled Dexter out of the pit.<ref name="CWA" />
